response.sql: WITH qualifying_patients AS (SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE `U-PRO` = '-' AND RA = '-'), patient_averages AS (SELECT qp.ID, AVG(l.PT) as pt_avg, AVG(l.TAT - l.TAT2) as tat_diff_avg FROM qualifying_patients qp JOIN Laboratory l ON qp.ID = l.ID GROUP BY qp.ID) SELECT AVG(pt_avg) as avg_pt, AVG(tat_diff_avg) as avg_tat_diff FROM patient_averages;
